details.eligibility: 12th pass (Intermediate) from a recognised board. Age limit as per CEN notification - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: CBT 1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. CBT 2: 120 questions. Negative marking 1/3 per wrong answer. Then Typing Skill Test for applicable posts, Document Verification and Medical Examination.
details.syllabus: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness.
details.important_dates: CEN 05/2024: Undergraduate CBT 1 held Aug-Sep 2025; CBT 2 held in 2025. (Per Testbook page.)

notes: ROUND 3 — 2026-11-21. Years by HELD date (round 1 used CEN year, so its Aug-Sep 2025-held papers are labelled 2024 there — do not duplicate). Undergraduate CBT 1 (CEN 06/2024) was held 7 Aug-9 Sep 2025. New 2026 cycle: UG CBT 1 held 7-9 May and 13-20 Jun 2026. No NTPC exam was held in 2023 or 2024 (Adda247). UG CBT 2 for the 2025-held cycle is listed on the round-1 Testbook hub; its dates were not separately verified here. No official paper PDFs exist: RRB publishes only answer keys/response sheets per CEN on rrbapply.gov.in and regional portals.
